title: Acme Logistics: refund status and late fee
transcript:
Agent: Acme support, this is Daniel. How can I help?
Customer: Hi, this is Priya from Acme Logistics. I am following up on a refund. We were told it would take five to seven business days.
Agent: Let me check. Can you confirm the invoice number and the card?
Customer: Invoice 8841, card ending 4417. The refund was for a duplicate charge of $120.
Agent: I see the refund was submitted on August 1. It is still processing. The current estimate is August 8.
Customer: Okay. The reason I am calling is that we also got hit with a $15 late fee because the duplicate charge threw off our balance. Can you waive that?
Agent: Let me look at the account. I see the late fee posted on August 2. I can reverse it as a courtesy. I will add a note to ticket T-1001 explaining that the fee was caused by the duplicate charge.
Customer: Thank you. Will the credit show up on the same statement as the refund?
Agent: The refund goes back to the card ending 4417. The fee waiver is an account credit, so it will appear on the next statement. You should see both within the same billing cycle.
Customer: Good. And the refund is still coming on the 8th?
Agent: Yes, August 8. I will send you an updated confirmation that lists the refund and the fee waiver together.
Customer: Perfect. One more thing. Our finance team wants to know whether the duplicate charge will affect autopay next month.
Agent: I have checked the autopay settings. The duplicate did not change the scheduled amount. I will add a note for the billing team to confirm the next draft before it runs.
Customer: That is all I needed. Thank you.
Agent: Thanks for calling. Have a good day.
